title: [synthetic] Velorin lowers fasting glucose in a mouse model
abstract: BACKGROUND
Velorin is a synthetic peptide invented for this toy corpus.
In treated mice, velorin lowered fasting blood glucose by a large margin.
Insulin sensitivity improved in the treated group.
Velorin did not change body weight.

title: [synthetic] Quastatin and liver enzymes
abstract: Quastatin is a fictional statin used for demonstration.
Patients receiving quastatin showed elevated liver enzymes.
The elevation resolved after stopping treatment.

title: [synthetic] TRX-9 protein in neuronal growth
abstract: The protein TRX-9 is expressed in developing neurons.
Knockdown of TRX-9 did not reduce axon growth in culture.
TRX-9 levels were higher in the cortex than in the cerebellum.

title: [synthetic] Daily walking and sleep quality in older adults
abstract: We followed older adults who walked daily for twelve weeks.
Daily walking improved sleep quality in older adults.
Daytime fatigue decreased in the walking group.

title: [synthetic] Mirelle syndrome prevalence
abstract: Mirelle syndrome is a fictional disorder defined for this demo.
Prevalence of Mirelle syndrome was one in five thousand births.
Prevalence of Mirelle syndrome was not higher in urban regions.

title: [synthetic] Coffee intake and reaction time
abstract: Methods:
Participants drank coffee before a reaction time task.
Coffee intake shortened reaction time in rested participants.
The effect was absent in sleep deprived participants.

title: [synthetic] Zinc supplementation and cold duration
abstract: Zinc supplementation did not shorten the duration of colds in this toy trial.
Adverse taste effects were common.

title: [synthetic] Soil bacteria strain K4 and plastic film
abstract: Strain K4 was isolated from compost soil.
Strain K4 degrades polyethylene film within sixty days.
Degradation required oxygen.

title: [synthetic] Blue light exposure and melatonin
abstract: Evening blue light exposure suppresses melatonin release.
Amber filters restored melatonin levels.

title: [synthetic] Ferrovane alloy fatigue
abstract: Ferrovane is a fictional alloy.
Ferrovane samples cracked after fewer load cycles than steel.

title: [synthetic] Gut microbiome diversity after antibiotics
abstract: Antibiotic courses reduce gut microbiome diversity.
Diversity recovered within three months in most participants.

title: [synthetic] Noise exposure and blood pressure in workers
abstract: Workers exposed to loud noise had higher blood pressure.
Hearing protection lowered blood pressure readings.
